Hi Mark,

I'm sorry. You ordered your Harlo B30 and Power Kit on September 12, and the November 14 ship date we gave you in our September 15 update passed yesterday without it going out.

This is where it stands now. Your order is paid and hasn't shipped yet. Your Power Kit is already set aside for you at our Tennessee warehouse. The B30 hasn't reached that warehouse yet. Your order goes out as soon as the B30 arrives and is checked in.

You can follow that batch on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

I don't want to give you another date that slips. I've asked the team to confirm when your B30 will ship. They're back tomorrow at 10am ET, and their answer will come to your email. Tracking will also be emailed to you as soon as it ships.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
